items.verbatim_quote: **Sparse-dictionary decomposition of activations.** The most-worked lane in the field: SAE features are "not better than neurons" on MIB [S10], the auto-interp metrics used to defend them fail a randomized baseline [S9], absorption is traced to the objective itself [S30], canonical-unit claims are refuted [S33], and the raw-latent steering/detection verdict plus its rebuttal are both published [S31] [S25].
items.second_quote: **Circuit-discovery methods and their corrections.** Attribution patching, its error diagnosis and second-order fix [S19], structural-vs-functional decoupling [S23], and an eight-method community bake-off [S22] are all published.
items.required_framing: W1-W4 are RAW-ACTIVATION DIRECTIONAL quantities and must stay outside both lanes IN THE TEXT, not merely in the code. This fence is sharper than it looks now that the nearest W4 neighbour, Conditional Co-Ablation (arXiv:2607.01940), is explicitly a transformer-CIRCUITS paper: W4 must be written as a per-checkpoint scalar over layer bands, never as circuit discovery.

items.owner_paper: mechanistic-interpretability field handbook; Minder, Dumas, Chughtai, Nanda (crosscoder L1 artifact); Ge et al. (ICLR 2026)
items.verbatim_quote: we identify two issues which stem from the crosscoders L1 training loss that can misattribute concepts as unique to the fine-tuned model, when they really exist in both models
items.second_quote: **Developmental / training-dynamics interpretability.** Feature evolution is already tracked across pre-training snapshots with crosscoders [S28] (ICLR 2026).
items.THE_SENTENCE_TO_USE_VERBATIM: Unlike crosscoder model diffing and training-dynamics checkpoint tracking, every quantity reported here is SELF-FITTED AND PARENT-FREE: no shared dictionary is trained across models, no checkpoint is compared against another checkpoint's basis, and each number is computable from one arbitrary HuggingFace repository alone -- which is precisely why it is immune to the crosscoder L1 artefact that can misattribute concepts as unique to a fine-tuned model when they exist in both.
